welcome.title: Welcome to OrgAdmin
welcome.content:
# Welcome to OrgAdmin

OrgAdmin is your comprehensive platform for managing your organisation's operations. Here's what you can do:

## Core Features

**User Management** - Create and manage user accounts, assign roles, and control permissions across your organisation.

**Forms & Data Collection** - Build custom forms to collect information from members, with flexible field types and validation.

**Event Management** - Create and manage events, track registrations, and communicate with attendees.

**Membership Management** - Handle membership subscriptions, renewals, and member data.

**Calendar & Bookings** - Manage bookable resources, appointments, and scheduling.

**Payment Processing** - Accept payments, track transactions, and manage financial records.

## Getting Started

Each module has its own introduction that will appear the first time you visit it. You can also access help at any time by clicking the help button (?) in the top right corner.

Ready to get started? Close this dialog and explore your dashboard!

dashboard.title: Dashboard Overview
dashboard.content:
# Dashboard

Your dashboard provides a quick overview of your organisation's key metrics and recent activity.

## What You'll See

- **Quick Stats** - Member counts, upcoming events, recent form submissions
- **Recent Activity** - Latest actions and updates across all modules
- **Shortcuts** - Quick access to common tasks
- **Notifications** - Important alerts and reminders

## Customization

You can customize which widgets appear on your dashboard and arrange them to suit your workflow.

Click "Got it" to start exploring your dashboard!

users.title: User Management
users.content:
# User Management

The Users module helps you manage all user accounts in your organisation.

## Key Features

- **View All Users** - Browse and search your complete user directory
- **Create Users** - Add new users manually or invite them via email
- **Assign Roles** - Control what users can access and do
- **Manage Permissions** - Fine-tune capabilities for each role
- **User Profiles** - View and edit detailed user information

## Getting Started

Start by browsing your existing users or create a new user account. You can assign roles to control access levels.

forms.title: Form Builder
forms.content:
# Forms Module

Create custom forms to collect information from your members and the public.

## What You Can Do

- **Build Forms** - Create forms with various field types (text, numbers, dates, dropdowns, etc.)
- **Field Validation** - Ensure data quality with built-in validation rules
- **Conditional Logic** - Show or hide fields based on user responses
- **Submissions** - View and manage all form submissions
- **Export Data** - Download submission data for analysis

## Form Types

Create registration forms, surveys, applications, feedback forms, and more. Forms can be embedded on your website or shared via direct links.

events.title: Event Management
events.content:
# Events Module

Plan, promote, and manage events for your organisation.

## Core Capabilities

- **Create Events** - Set up events with dates, locations, and descriptions
- **Registration** - Accept event registrations with custom forms
- **Capacity Management** - Set attendance limits and waitlists
- **Communication** - Send updates and reminders to attendees
- **Check-in** - Track attendance on event day
- **Reporting** - Analyze registration and attendance data

## Event Types

Manage meetings, workshops, conferences, social gatherings, and any other type of event your organisation hosts.

memberships.title: Membership Management
memberships.content:
# Memberships Module

Manage your organisation's membership program and member relationships.

## Key Features

- **Membership Types** - Define different membership tiers and benefits
- **Subscriptions** - Handle recurring memberships with automatic renewals
- **Member Records** - Maintain detailed member profiles and history
- **Renewals** - Track expiration dates and send renewal reminders
- **Member Portal** - Give members access to their own information
- **Reporting** - Analyze membership trends and retention

## Getting Started

Set up your membership types, then start adding members or allow them to self-register through your website.

calendar.title: Calendar & Bookings
calendar.content:
# Calendar & Bookings

Manage bookable resources, appointments, and scheduling for your organisation.

## What You Can Do

- **Create Calendars** - Set up calendars for rooms, equipment, staff, or services
- **Define Availability** - Set when resources are available for booking
- **Accept Bookings** - Let users book time slots online
- **Manage Appointments** - View, edit, and cancel bookings
- **Prevent Conflicts** - Automatic conflict detection and prevention
- **Notifications** - Send booking confirmations and reminders

## Use Cases

Perfect for meeting room bookings, equipment rentals, appointment scheduling, class registrations, and more.

payments.title: Payment Processing
payments.content:
# Payments Module

Accept and manage payments for memberships, events, and other services.

## Core Features

- **Payment Collection** - Accept credit cards, bank transfers, and other payment methods
- **Transaction History** - View all payment transactions
- **Invoicing** - Generate and send invoices
- **Refunds** - Process refunds when needed
- **Reporting** - Financial reports and reconciliation
- **Security** - PCI-compliant payment processing

## Integration

Payments are integrated throughout OrgAdmin - collect fees during event registration, membership signup, and more.

merchandise.title: Merchandise
merchandise.content:
# Merchandise Module

Create and sell products through your organisation's online store.

## Key Features

- **Product Management** - Create merchandise types with images, descriptions, and pricing
- **Variants & Options** - Define sizes, colours, and other product options
- **Stock Tracking** - Monitor inventory levels with low-stock alerts
- **Order Management** - View and process orders, handle fulfilment
- **Handling Fees** - Configure additional fees per item
- **Discounts** - Create promotional discounts and codes

## Getting Started

Create your first merchandise type, add images and pricing, then publish it for your members to purchase.

registrations.title: Registrations
registrations.content:
# Registrations Module

Manage sign-ups and enrolments for your organisation's programmes and activities.

## Key Features

- **Registration Types** - Create different registration categories for programmes, classes, and activities
- **Registration Database** - View and manage all registrations with advanced filtering
- **Batch Operations** - Process multiple registrations at once with labels and status updates
- **Custom Filters** - Save filter sets for quick access to common views
- **Excel Export** - Download registration data for reporting
- **Payment Integration** - Collect fees during the registration process

## Getting Started

Set up your registration types, then start accepting registrations from your members.

ticketing.title: Event Ticketing
ticketing.content:
# Event Ticketing Module

Manage ticket sales and attendance across all your ticketed events.

## Key Features

- **Ticketed Events Overview** - See all events with ticketing enabled at a glance
- **Ticket Configuration** - Set up ticket types, pricing, and capacity per event
- **Sales Monitoring** - Track ticket sales in real time
- **Attendee Management** - View ticket holders and check-in status
- **Revenue Tracking** - Monitor ticket revenue per event

## Getting Started

Enable ticketing on your events from the event edit page, then manage all ticketed events from this module.

settings.title: Organisation Settings
settings.content:
# Settings Module

Configure your organisation's profile, payment settings, and preferences.

## Key Areas

- **Organisation Details** - Update your organisation's name, description, and contact information
- **Payment Settings** - Configure payment methods and processing options
- **Email Templates** - Customise automated email communications
- **Branding** - Set your organisation's logo, colours, and visual identity

## Getting Started

Review your organisation details and ensure your payment settings are configured correctly.
